title: CraftConquest: Evolved
description: You might regret playing this modpack.
body:
# CraftConquest: Evolved
The next "CraftConquest" pack, this time we aren't doing horror _(If you want horror, check out [Chronicles](https://modrinth.com/modpack/craftconquest/))_, this time the pack is meant to be challenging, how challenging? That's for you to decide.
